weight_economy.value: 1 piece up to 10 kg + 1 personal item

weight_business.value: 2 carry-on bags up to 10 kg each, plus 1 personal item
weight_business.notes: Carry-on baggage page, Business: "Not exceeding 10kg per carry-on bag".

personal_item.value: Up to 40 x 30 x 20 cm, stowed under the seat in front: a handbag, briefcase or laptop bag

weight_business_first.value: 2 pieces up to 10 kg each + 1 personal item (Business Smartium / Business Suite)

piece_weight_economy.value: 1 piece up to 23 kg (50 lbs) (2 pieces on Americas routes)

piece_weight_business.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each (Business Smartium)

size_weight.value: Each bag up to 158 cm (62 in) total, wheels and handles included, in every class
size_weight.notes: Free baggage page: "Regardless of your class, the maximum size per bag is 158cm(62 inch)."

piece_weight_first.value: 3 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each (Business Suite)

fare_name.notes: flyasiana.com English pages publish no named international economy fare family; refund and change rules are listed by booking class instead.

seat_selection_included.notes: Not stated per fare on the pages read.

change_cancellation_policy.notes: Refund penalties vary by booking class and haul (ticket-information page); no single cheapest-fare rule to publish.

online_checkin.value: International: 48 hours to 1 hour before departure (U.S. routes, including Saipan, from 24 hours); domestic Korea: 24 hours to 30 minutes before

online_checkin_opens.value: 48 hours before departure (24 hours for US/Canada flights)

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

cancellation_refund.value: Tickets unused because of a cancellation for weather or airline reasons are not refunded automatically; refund fees are waived, though online or mobile refunds may carry a processing fee

us_refund_timing.value: On flights to and from the U.S., cancellations and delays of 6 hours or more qualify for a refund within 7 business days (cards) or 20 days (other payment), or a credit valid 5 years
us_refund_timing.notes: Ticket information page, U.S. irregular-operations refund notice, effective 28 Oct 2024.

duty_of_care_policy.notes: Meals, hotel and rebooking commitments are in the Customer Service Plan and Conditions of Carriage PDFs, whose path robots.txt disallows; not fetched.

care.value: Meals, beverages, telephone access, and hotel accommodation for overnight delays under Korean MOLIT rules.

rebooking_refund.value: Choice of full refund or rebooking to final destination free of charge for cancellations or delays >3 hours.

compensation.value: Statutory compensation provided according to Korean MOLIT guidelines or EU 261 for EU departures.

korean_air_integration.value: Asiana joins Korean Air on 17 December 2026: flights from that date use Korean Air flight numbers, and flyasiana.com redirects to Korean Air after 16 December 2026
korean_air_integration.notes: Integration FAQ: "On December 17, 2026, Asiana Airlines and Korean Air unite". Bookings move to Korean Air from 2 Nov 2026; Asiana handles changes and refunds until the integration date.

phone_home_market.notes: Book-online page, Service Guide table. Asiana flights move to Korean Air flight numbers on 17 Dec 2026; re-check after that date.

phone_us.notes: Book-online page, Service Guide table. Opening hours differ between pages, so none are given.

conditions_of_carriage_url.notes: Contract of Carriage and Notifications page, which links the conditions-of-carriage PDFs.

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard Economy, Duo Seats, Business Smartium lie-flat suites, Business Suite.

reserved_or_random.value: Free advance seat selection for standard Economy; unreserved assigned free at check-in.

family_seating.value: Asiana automatically seats children under 12 with an accompanying adult during seat allocation.
